message.content:
Build a complete settings page overhaul for the Zip Code Checker Shopify app. This requires changes to 4 files.

## What to build:

### 1. Add `ShopSettings` model to `prisma/schema.prisma`

Add this model at the end (before the last line):
```prisma
model ShopSettings {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop              String   @unique
  defaultBehavior   String   @default("block") // "block" = block all unlisted zips, "allow" = allow all unlisted zips
  notificationEmail String?  // email to receive waitlist notifications
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
}
```

### 2. Run migration
Run: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_shop_settings`

### 3. Update `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx`

In the `handleZipCheck` function, after fetching widgetConfig, also fetch shopSettings:
```typescript
const shopSettings = await db.shopSettings.findUnique({ where: { shop } });
const defaultBehavior = shopSettings?.defaultBehavior ?? "block";
```

Then when `!zipRecord || !zipRecord.isActive`:
- If `!zipRecord` AND `defaultBehavior === "allow"`: return `{ allowed: true, message: widgetConfig?.successMessage ?? "We deliver to your area!", eta: null, zone: null, showWaitlist: false }`  
- Otherwise: existing "not found" behavior

### 4. Completely rewrite `app/routes/app.settings.tsx`

Replace the entire file with a proper settings page. Read the current file first to understand existing imports and patterns.

The new page should have these sections in order:

**Section 1: Subscription** (keep existing logic, improve UI)
- Current plan badge (tone based on planTier)  
- Billing interval if on paid plan
- "Upgrade Plan" or "Manage Plan" button

**Section 2: Zip Code Behavior** (NEW - most important)
- Heading: "Default Behavior for Unknown Zip Codes"
- Description: "Choose what happens when a customer enters a zip code that isn't in your list."
- A Select component with options:
  - `{ label: "Block — show 'not available' message (recommended)", value: "block" }`
  - `{ label: "Allow — treat as available (for stores with broad coverage)", value: "allow" }`
- Save button for this section
- Note below: "This only applies to zip codes not in your list. Explicitly blocked zip codes are always blocked."

**Section 3: Notifications** (NEW)
- Heading: "Waitlist Notifications"  
- Description: "Get notified by email when customers join the waitlist."
- TextField for notification email (type email, placeholder "your@email.com")
- Save button for this section
- Note: If left empty, no email notifications are sent.

**Section 4: Usage & Limits** (keep existing, improve)
- Zip Codes Used: count / limit
- Blocked Zip Codes: Enabled/Not Available
- Store: shop domain

**Section 5: Data Management** (NEW)
- Heading: "Data Management"
- 3 plain buttons in a row:
  - "Export Zip Codes" → navigate("/app/zip-codes") (for now)
  - "View Waitlist" → navigate("/app/waitlist")
  - "Manage Delivery Rules" → navigate("/app/delivery-rules")

**Section 6: Support** (NEW)
- Heading: "Help & Support"
- Two items:
  - "Documentation" with description "Learn how to set up and use Zip Code Checker" — link to `https://help.shopify.com` (placeholder, use Button variant="plain" external)
  - "Contact Support" with description "Get help from our team" — link using Button variant="plain"

### Action handler pattern:
The action should handle TWO intents:
- `intent: "save-behavior"` → upsert ShopSettings with `defaultBehavior`
- `intent: "save-notification"` → upsert ShopSettings with `notificationEmail`

Use `fetcher.submit()` pattern for each save button, with `useAppBridge` for toast on success.

### Code rules:
- Use ONLY Polaris v13 components (Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Select, TextField, Button, Badge, Divider, Banner, Box)
- Import `useFetcher` from react-router for form submissions  
- Import `useAppBridge` from @shopify/app-bridge-react for toast
- Follow the exact same pattern as `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` for action/loader structure
- The loader must call `authenticate.admin(request)` first
- Handle errors in action with try/catch, return `{ error: "..." }` or `{ success: true }`
- Add loading states: `isSavingBehavior` and `isSavingNotification` derived from fetcher state
- Show toast on save success using `shopify.toast.show("Settings saved")`

Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_shop_settings` after updating the schema.

After all changes, list all files modified.
